justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bind/annotation/FieldProxy.java, where the nested FieldSetter class spans a single focused responsibility: it stores three dependencies, exposes only a constructor, prepare(), and appender(), and its nested Appender adds only one apply() method to emit setter bytecode.
